catdesc_camera: How cell motion is interpolated and how the camera follows.
catdesc_chat: How chat is shown and notified.
catdesc_colors: Theme and setting colors. Themes can be exported to a file and shared with others.
catdesc_hotkeys: Key bindings and macros. Click a name to bind a key.
catdesc_hud: Display settings for on-screen HUD elements.
catdesc_net: What happens when the connection to the server drops.
catdesc_render: Rendering quality, performance and visual effects.
cursorImageHint: PNG up to 128px, center is the click point
desc_AffectZoomingOnReplay: Uses the zoom from the recording during playback.
desc_AniBorder: Draws the field border in a rainbow gradient.
desc_AniHalfSplit: Draws the half-split marker in a rainbow gradient.
desc_AniVirus: Draws viruses in a rainbow gradient.
desc_AutoReconnect: When the server drops the connection, reconnect automatically; off means the tab stays disconnected until you refresh it.
desc_CameraMode: How the camera centers on your cells: Default weights by mass; Unit center uses the middle of all cells; Cell average averages positions ignoring mass.
desc_CameraMovementSpeed: How fast the camera catches up; higher follows tighter, lower is smoother. Also used when spectating and in replays.
desc_CameraZoomSpeed: How much each wheel notch zooms.
desc_CellCameraSpeed: How fast the camera catches up; higher follows tighter.
desc_CellShadow: Adds a faint shadow around cell edges.
desc_CellShadowIntensity: How dark the cell shadow is.
desc_ChatMaxMessages: How many messages are shown at once; older ones are kept and load as you scroll up.
desc_ChatMentionNotify: When someone else's message contains @your name (either tab's name), the message is highlighted in the chat log.
desc_CursorImageUri: Image URL for the custom cursor. Browsers ignore cursor images larger than 128px, so a crosshair is shown instead.
desc_CursorStyle: Mouse cursor shape over the game. Custom image uses the cursor image below.
desc_FrameRateOption: Share of frames that get drawn.
desc_GlowingBorder: Adds a glow to the field border.
desc_GpuCellRenderer: Drawing backend; Auto picks one for your browser.
desc_HideMenuAfterDeath: Stays on the game screen instead of opening the main menu after death.
desc_InterpolationSpeed: Higher reaches new positions faster; lower is smoother but lags behind.
desc_InterpolationType: How cells animate to new positions. Fast and Linear move straight in fixed time; Preceding leads slightly along the motion; Chase closes a share of the gap each frame; Timed and Softened use the animation settings below.
desc_JellyCells: Makes cell edges wobble like jelly.
desc_MinTextSize: Text smaller than this on screen is skipped; your own cells always show text.
desc_MiniMapAniBorder: Draws the minimap border in a rainbow gradient.
desc_MiniMapAnimInterval: Color cycling speed of the gradient minimap border; higher is faster, 0 stops it.
desc_MiniMapDrawMode: Total: one dot per player scaled by size. Real cells: cells in view are drawn as they are; those out of view fall back to totals.
desc_MiniMapGlowingBorder: Adds a glow inside the minimap border.
desc_MiniMapNameTeamColor: Draw each name in its minimap dot's color (the team color in team modes).
desc_MiniMapNameZoom: Size of the names drawn on the minimap.
desc_MiniMapOpaque: Keeps every minimap dot fully opaque while you play. When off, other players are drawn at 37.5% and your own cells stay opaque. While spectating, everything is opaque.
desc_MiniMapShowCoord: Draws the A1–E5 grid on the minimap.
desc_MiniMapShowCrosshair: Draws a crosshair through the center of your screen that spans the whole minimap.
desc_MiniMapShowSelfName: Also labels your own dot on the minimap with your name, following the same rules as other players. Mass is never shown on your own dot.
desc_MiniMapShowView: Outlines the part of the map currently visible on your screen.
desc_OverlapMarker: Marks where cells overlap; Auto only for cells of 10,000 mass or more.
desc_OverlapMarkerMask: Draws the overlap marker only where cells intersect; no effect while the overlap marker is off.
desc_PelletCellsAlpha: Opacity of pellets and ejected mass.
desc_PlayerLabelsAlpha: Opacity of name and mass text.
desc_QualityPreset: Applies a combination of render scale and texture quality at once.
desc_QuickCaptureTimeOption: How many recent seconds quick capture keeps.
desc_QuickChat1: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat10: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat2: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat3: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat4: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat5: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat6: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat7: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat8: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_QuickChat9: Leave empty to send the default line. Default lines go out in English and other players of this client see them in their own language. %sector% becomes the square you are in.
desc_ReconnectDoubling: Each failed attempt doubles the wait (for example 5, 10, 20, 40… seconds), up to 60 seconds. Off waits the reconnect interval every time. The wait goes back to the interval once a connection opens.
desc_ReconnectInterval: Seconds to wait before the first reconnect attempt.
desc_ReconnectTries: Reconnect attempts in a row before giving up. The count starts over once a connection opens or when you refresh the tab.
desc_RenderQuality: Resolution of skin and text textures.
desc_RenderScale: Render resolution relative to the screen; lower is lighter.
desc_RenderingTimeOffset: Advances animation by the frame's draw time to offset rendering delay; 0 is off. Linear, Timed and Softened only.
desc_ReplayBuffer: Keep recording the last stretch of play so Quick capture can save it. Records even when the replay bar is hidden.
desc_ResetReplayWhenChangeServer: Clears the recording and saved replay clips when switching servers.
desc_ShowAutoSplitAlert: Flashes when a cell is close to auto-splitting.
desc_ShowCellDirectionMarker: Draws a short line on each player cell's edge pointing where it is moving.
desc_ShowCellRing: Adds an outline to cells in the complement of the cell's color.
desc_ShowChatBox: Hides the chat log; you can still type, and @mention notices still show in the notice line.
desc_ShowCircularName: Wraps names around the edge of the cell.
desc_ShowClSelfCell: Paints your cells with the self cell colors from Colors.
desc_ShowClientStatus: Shows FPS and network latency in the bottom left.
desc_ShowCoord: Draws the A1–E5 grid on the field.
desc_ShowCursorLine: Draws lines from your cells to the cursor.
desc_ShowHalfSplit: Marks the cell that can half-split.
desc_ShowLeaderboard: Shows the player and team rankings.
desc_ShowMap: Shows the minimap in the bottom right with player positions.
desc_ShowMapName: Shows player names on the minimap.
desc_ShowMassMarker: Colors other cells by mass ratio to your biggest cell: edible, dangerous, double-splittable and so on.
desc_ShowName: Shows names on other players' cells.
desc_ShowOrderRing: When multiboxing, rings of different colors show which tab or Unit you are controlling.
desc_ShowReplayBar: Show the replay bar. Recording is controlled by Replay buffer.
desc_ShowSelfName: Also shows the name on your own cells.
desc_ShowSelfPanel: Shows your score, sector and cell count for each tab.
desc_ShowServerStatus: Shows the server name, game mode, load and uptime in the bottom left.
desc_ShowSkin: Master switch for skins; choose your own and other players' separately.
desc_ShowSplitIndicator: Outlines what a split toward the mouse can reach, using another color for what it can eat.
desc_ShowSplitPrediction: Colors your cells' outlines by split order.
desc_ShowUI: Shows the leaderboard, minimap, status info, chat and replay bar.
desc_ShowUnitArrow: Adds an arrow to the cells of the unit you are controlling.
desc_ShowfieldBackImage: Shows a background image on the field.
desc_SimpleVirus: Draws viruses as plain circles without spikes.
desc_SimplifiedMass: Shows mass of 1000 or more in K, e.g. 1.9K.
desc_SinglePelletsColor: Paints all pellets with the pellet color from Colors.
desc_SmoothSkin: Downscales skins with high quality; switching reloads skins.
desc_SoftenAnimation: Higher makes movement smoother but adds delay.
desc_TimedAnimation: Time cells take to reach new positions; longer is smoother but adds delay.
desc_TogglePlayerTransparentCells: Makes player cells translucent using Player cell opacity.
desc_TouchButtonAlpha: Opacity of the touch buttons; lower is more transparent.
desc_TouchButtonSize: Size of the touch action buttons.
desc_TouchFollowFinger: On: cells move toward your finger. Off: steer with the virtual joystick.
desc_TouchLeftHanded: Moves the action buttons to the bottom left and the joystick to the right half.
desc_TouchVibrate: Vibrates briefly when you press a touch button.
desc_UnitCameraSpeed: How fast the camera catches up; higher follows tighter.
desc_VideoExportQuality: Quality of exported videos; higher means larger files.
desc_VirusSplitHint: Shows how many feeds each virus still needs before it splits, instead of its mass.
desc_animInterval: Color cycling speed of gradient viruses, half-split marker and border; higher is faster, 0 stops it.
desc_invisibleSelfCell: Your own cells are not shown at all.
desc_massOverlapSize: Cells above this mass always draw their mass text on top; has no effect while the overlap marker is on.
